_readme: Reusable black-halftone photographs for the homepage 'Website of the Day' feature, matched to websites by tags (data/SCHEMA.md, 'Website of the Day'; tools/EDITORIAL_LIBRARY_WORKFLOW.md). NOT one photograph per website. status 'reserve' = kept, never matched. Paths are relative to the site root; masters live in images/resources/_masters/library/ (not published). Every entry's credit line is shown on the homepage.
